about

Why work with me

FKM

I'm Francis Kelvin Mkanda, a brand and web specialist based in Malawi, working with small businesses and entrepreneurs across Africa and beyond. I don't just design a logo or build a site — I connect brand identity, web development, data analysis, and hands-on support into one process, so what I hand you actually works for your customers, not just in a portfolio screenshot.

Every project is built mobile-first, because that's how most of your customers will actually find you — on a phone, often on a slower connection. I design and build with that reality in mind from the first sketch, not as an afterthought. Understanding the African market means understanding data costs, screen sizes, and trust signals that templates built for other markets simply miss.

I also stay close to the work after launch. I test with real people, train your team to use what I've built, and fix what breaks — because a brand or website only earns its value once people can actually use it. That combination is what clients keep coming back for.
